SELECT 1 AS DAYS, COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_CODE) AS DAY_COUNT, SUM(DAY_1) AS QTY FROM t_mp_moulding_day_result WHERE PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DAY_1 > 0
UNION ALL SELECT ${day} AS DAYS, COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_CODE) AS DAY_COUNT, SUM(DAY_${day}) AS QTY FROM t_mp_moulding_day_result WHERE PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DAY_${day} > 0

MAX(allocation.ptPlanQty) AS ptPlanQty, MAX(allocation.thPlanQty) AS thPlanQty, MAX(allocation.kzPlanQty) AS kzPlanQty, MAX(allocation.rtPlanQty) AS rtPlanQty, MAX(allocation.wmPlanQty) AS wmPlanQty, MAX(stockUp1.inStockUpPlanQty) AS inStockUpPlanQty, MAX(stockUp.outMonthAvgSaleQty) AS outMonthAvgSaleQty, MAX(stockUp1.outStockUpRate) AS outStockUpRate, MAX(stockUp1.outStockUpPlanQty) AS AS totalStockUpQty, MAX(allocation.totalAllocationQty) AS totalAllocationQty, MAX(allocation.totalProduceQty) AS totalProduceQty, SUM(a.TOTAL_QTY) AS totalProductQty, SUM(CASE WHEN a.CHANNEL IS NULL FROM T_MP_MOULDING_DAY_RESULT a
LEFT JOIN (select PRODUCT_CODE, SUM(stock_qty) stockQty from t_mp_month_require_stock where `YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` = (#{month} - 1) and is_delete = 0 and month_plan_version = (SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION FROM t_mp_proc_version WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion}) GROUP BY PRODUCT_CODE) stock on a.PRODUCT_CODE = stock.PRODUCT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (select product_code, ROUND(SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN AVERAGE_VALUE END) / 3) as inMonthAvgSaleQty, ROUND(SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 2 THEN AVERAGE_VALUE END) / 3) as outMonthAvgSaleQty, ROUND(SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 3 THEN AVERAGE_VALUE END) / 3) as oeMonthAvgSaleQty from T_MDM_STOCK_UP_PLAN where
(`YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` <= #{month}) OR (`YEAR` = #{year} - 1 AND `MONTH` >= (#{month} + 9))
`YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` <= #{month} AND `MONTH` >= (#{month} - 3 )
group by product_code) stockUp on a.PRODUCT_CODE = stockUp.product_code
LEFT JOIN (select product_code, MAX(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN factor END) as inStockUpRate, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN stock_qty END) as inStockUpPlanQty, MAX(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 2 THEN factor END) as outStockUpRate, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 2 THEN stock_qty END) as outStockUpPlanQty, MAX(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 3 THEN factor END) as oeStockUpRate, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 3 THEN stock_qty END) as oeStockUpPlanQty, SUM(stock_qty) AS totalStockUpQty from T_MDM_STOCK_UP_PLAN where `YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` = #{month} group by product_code) stockUp1 on a.PRODUCT_CODE = stockUp1.product_code
LEFT JOIN (select PRODUCT_CODE, sum(case when LOCATION_TYPE = 1 then plan_qty else 0 end) inPlanQty, sum(case when LOCATION_TYPE = 2 then plan_qty else 0 end) outPlanQty, sum(case when LOCATION_TYPE = 3 then plan_qty else 0 end) oePlanQty, sum(plan_qty) totalPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '01' then plan_qty else 0 end) ptPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '02' then plan_qty else 0 end) thPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '03' then plan_qty else 0 end) kzPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '04' then plan_qty else 0 end) rtPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '05' then plan_qty else 0 end) wmPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '09' then plan_qty else 0 end) kaPlanQty, sum(ALLOCATION_QTY) totalAllocationQty, sum(PRODUCE_QTY_DUE) totalProduceQty from T_MP_ORDER_PLAN_ALLOCATION where `YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` = #{month} AND is_delete = 0 and MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = (SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION FROM t_mp_proc_version WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion}) group by PRODUCT_CODE) allocation ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = allocation.PRODUCT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (SELECT PRODUCT_CODE, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_CONTINUE) = 1 THEN '续作' END AS continueFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_IMPORTANT_CUSTOM) = 1 THEN '重要客户' END AS importantCustomFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_ENSURE_PLAN) = 1 THEN '必保' END AS ensurePlanFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_EMERGENCY) = 1 THEN '急单' END AS emergencyFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_DEBIT_PLAN) = 1 THEN '欠产' END AS debitPlanFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_STOCK_UP) = 1 THEN '有备货' END AS stockUpFlag, CASE WHEN MIN(DELIVERY_DATE_DUE) IS NOT NULL THEN '交期' END AS dateDueFlag FROM t_mp_proc_month_plan_init WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND `YEAR` = #{year} AND `MONTH` = #{month} AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} GROUP BY PRODUCT_CODE) init ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = init.PRODUCT_CODE
WHERE a.IS_DELETE = 0 AND a.`YEAR` = #{year} AND a.`MONTH` = #{month} AND a.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} and INSTR(a.PRODUCT_CODE, #{productCode}) > 0 and INSTR(a.SPEC_CODE, #{specCode}) > 0 and INSTR(a.EMBRYO_CODE, #{embryoCode}) > 0 and INSTR(a.PRODUCT_DESC, #{productDesc}) > 0 and a.LOCATION_TYPE = #{locationType} and a.CHANNEL = #{channel} and a.BRAND = #{brand} and INSTR(a.SPECIFICATIONS, #{specifications}) > 0 and a.PRO_SIZE = #{proSize} and INSTR(a.PATTERN, #{pattern}) > 0 and INSTR(a.MOULD_NO, #{mouldNo}) > 0
GROUP BY a.FACTORY_CODE, a.`YEAR`, a.`MONTH`, a.PRODUCT_CODE

LEFT JOIN (select PRODUCT_CODE, SUM(stock_qty) stockQty from t_mp_month_require_stock where `YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` = (#{month} - 1) and is_delete = 0 and month_plan_version = (SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION FROM t_mp_proc_version WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion}) GROUP BY PRODUCT_CODE) stock on a.PRODUCT_CODE = stock.PRODUCT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (select product_code, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN AVERAGE_VALUE END) as inMonthAvgSaleQty, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 2 THEN AVERAGE_VALUE END) as outMonthAvgSaleQty, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 3 THEN AVERAGE_VALUE END) as oeMonthAvgSaleQty from T_MDM_STOCK_UP_PLAN where
(`YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` <= #{month}) OR (`YEAR` = #{year} - 1 AND `MONTH` >= (#{month} + 9))
`YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` <= #{month} AND `MONTH` >= (#{month} - 3 )
group by product_code) stockUp on a.PRODUCT_CODE = stockUp.product_code
LEFT JOIN (select product_code, MAX(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN factor END) as inStockUpRate, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 1 THEN stock_qty END) as inStockUpPlanQty, MAX(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 2 THEN factor END) as outStockUpRate, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 2 THEN stock_qty END) as outStockUpPlanQty, MAX(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 3 THEN factor END) as oeStockUpRate, SUM(CASE LOCATION_TYPE WHEN 3 THEN stock_qty END) as oeStockUpPlanQty, SUM(stock_qty) AS totalStockUpQty from T_MDM_STOCK_UP_PLAN where `YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` = #{month} group by product_code) stockUp1 on a.PRODUCT_CODE = stockUp1.product_code
LEFT JOIN (select PRODUCT_CODE, sum(case when LOCATION_TYPE = 1 then plan_qty else 0 end) inPlanQty, sum(case when LOCATION_TYPE = 2 then plan_qty else 0 end) outPlanQty, sum(case when LOCATION_TYPE = 3 then plan_qty else 0 end) oePlanQty, sum(plan_qty) totalPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '01' then plan_qty else 0 end) ptPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '02' then plan_qty else 0 end) thPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '03' then plan_qty else 0 end) kzPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '04' then plan_qty else 0 end) rtPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '05' then plan_qty else 0 end) wmPlanQty, sum(case when CHANNEL = '09' then plan_qty else 0 end) kaPlanQty, sum(ALLOCATION_QTY) totalAllocationQty, sum(PRODUCE_QTY_DUE) totalProduceQty from T_MP_ORDER_PLAN_ALLOCATION where `YEAR` = #{year} and `MONTH` = #{month} AND is_delete = 0 and MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = (SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION FROM t_mp_proc_version WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion}) group by PRODUCT_CODE) allocation ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = allocation.PRODUCT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (SELECT PRODUCT_CODE, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_CONTINUE) = 1 THEN '续作' END AS continueFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_IMPORTANT_CUSTOM) = 1 THEN '重要客户' END AS importantCustomFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_ENSURE_PLAN) = 1 THEN '必保' END AS ensurePlanFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_EMERGENCY) = 1 THEN '急单' END AS emergencyFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_DEBIT_PLAN) = 1 THEN '欠产' END AS debitPlanFlag, CASE WHEN MAX(IS_STOCK_UP) = 1 THEN '有备货' END AS stockUpFlag, CASE WHEN MIN(DELIVERY_DATE_DUE) IS NOT NULL THEN '交期' END AS dateDueFlag FROM t_mp_proc_month_plan_init WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND `YEAR` = #{year} AND `MONTH` = #{month} AND PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} GROUP BY PRODUCT_CODE) init ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = init.PRODUCT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.PRODUCT_CODE, sum(f.DAY_FINISH_QTY) finish_qty FROM t_lh_day_finish_qty f WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (( -- 上个月 26 - 31 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-26'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month} - 1, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) ) OR ( -- 本月 1 - 25 日的数据 f.FINISH_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month}, '-25'), '%Y-%m-%d') )) GROUP BY f.PRODUCT_CODE) finish on a.PRODUCT_CODE = finish.PRODUCT_CODE
LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_info proInfo ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = proInfo.PRODUCT_CODE and a.factory_code = proInfo.factory_code LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_construction proCon ON a.PRODUCT_CODE = proCon.PRODUCT_CODE and a.factory_code = proCon.factory_code LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on proCon.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.embryo_code and proCon.BOM_VERSION = ci.EMBRYO_VERSION /*施工信息表*/
WHERE a.IS_DELETE = 0 AND a.`YEAR` = #{year} AND a.`MONTH` = #{month} AND a.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} and INSTR(a.PRODUCT_CODE, #{productCode}) > 0 and INSTR(a.SPEC_CODE, #{specCode}) > 0 and INSTR(a.EMBRYO_CODE, #{embryoCode}) > 0 and INSTR(a.PRODUCT_DESC, #{productDesc}) > 0 and a.LOCATION_TYPE = #{locationType} and a.CHANNEL = #{channel} and a.BRAND = #{brand} and INSTR(a.SPECIFICATIONS, #{specifications}) > 0 and a.PRO_SIZE = #{proSize} and INSTR(a.PATTERN, #{pattern}) > 0 and INSTR(a.MOULD_NO, #{mouldNo}) > 0
GROUP BY a.FACTORY_CODE, a.`YEAR`, a.`MONTH`, a.PRODUCT_CODE
